messages:
Alex (they/them): ok so I tried a new WFH hack — tiny hamster wheel under my standing desk + laptop tray. photos incoming. might be the cardio upgrade we didn't ask for :rofl:
Maria: please tell me this is not an actual hamster treadmill 😂
Devin: pics or it didn't happen. also how's your hotspot stability when ISP flakes?
Sam: @Alex love the energy. does it make your webcam wobble? could be a new zoom background 
Alex (they/them): pics: https://imgur.com/a/mini-wheel (no furry friends harmed, it’s one of those manual mini-wheels used as a foot-massager). works surprisingly well for ankle circulation. also my home ISP dropped for ~2m earlier — phone hotspot saved me. quick speedcheck: 27/8 Mbps
WiFiBot: note: detected outage in ZIP 94107 11:03–11:05 UTC, ISP reported brief maintenance window (logged by WiFiBot)
Maria: hah the combo of hamster-wheel ambulatory and hotspot-roulette. battery life kill?
Devin: anker 26800 here, surviving 6+ hours of tethering. pro tip: enable 5G preferred on tether settings if your phone supports it
Sam: :thumbsup: battery recs. @Alex can you gif the walk-and-type for tomorrow's standup?
Alex (they/them): posted a tiny clip in #random-media. also here's a tiny monitor script i toss in when my ISP is meh:
```bash
while true; do curl -s --head https://status.redwood.com | head -n 1; sleep 10; done
```
Maria: that's going in my emergency snippets folder :ok_hand: 
Devin: LOL, standing desk hamster hustle is peak WFH ingenuity
Sam: subscribe me to the newsletter — 'Innovations in Foot-Powered Productivity' :laughing:
